title: Add signed release coverage manifests and verified downloads
author: w0F5vYijNonu8kkqLSa_jYY4GIV-Q5HpbxYY525ggm4

events.title: Add signed release coverage manifests and verified downloads
events.body:
## Outcome

Preserve and serve releases as signed, content-addressed collections rather than treating tags as the entire release.

## Implementation

- Define a release manifest binding tag, commit, release notes, binaries, checksums, software bills of materials, provenance attestations, documentation snapshots, and package-reference metadata.
- Store assets by digest and sign the manifest with a scoped release identity from #447.
- Mirror assets with streaming, range resume, byte accounting, and explicit missing, partial, corrupt, or complete coverage.
- Serve a stable verified download path that checks manifest identity and bytes before marking success.
- Include release and artifact coverage in migration reports, availability, offline bundles, and package provenance.

## Acceptance criteria

- Downloaded bytes always verify against the signed manifest.
- A tag movement, asset substitution, checksum mismatch, or untrusted signer is visible and rejected by default.
- Large downloads resume without buffering the full asset.
- Partial mirrors never present an unavailable asset as preserved.
- Documentation and package references remain browsable when the original publication endpoint is absent.

## Dependencies

Uses scoped identities from #447 and feeds #441, #445, #466, and #467.

## Verification

Publish, mirror, interrupt, resume, corrupt, partially remove, migrate, bundle, and download a multi-asset release; verify every state, checksum, signer, byte count, and offline documentation path.
